regions.today: Warm and humid in most areas today with sunny spells, the best of which will be in the east of Leinster. It will be cloudier in the south, with some light rain or drizzle possible. Highest temperatures of 20 to 26 degrees in mostly moderate southwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: Humid and largely dry tonight with a mix of cloud and clear spells. A little light rain or drizzle is possible. Temperatures will not fall below 13 to 17 degrees in mostly light southwesterly breezes with some mist and fog forming.
regions.tomorrow: A mix of cloud and sunny spells tomorrow morning with the odd spot of light rain or drizzle possible. Patchy rain will begin to push in from the northwest towards midday, gradually clearing southeastwards from most with drier and brighter conditions following. Highest temperatures of 17 to 23 degrees, warmest in the southeast, in light to moderate southwest to west winds.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high Tuesday and Wednesday.
